review_comment: The code marks user-controlled URL values as safe HTML after URL encoding but without validating dangerous protocol schemes. This could allow JavaScript protocol injection if smart_urlquote doesn't properly neutralize such schemes. Implement URL scheme validation using an allowlist approach before marking as safe, or avoid mark_safe() for user-controlled href attributes entirely.
